s00456.summary: Five teens pass a flask in an empty pool, teasing Tibby and Del.
Tibby announces he got into Michigan; Del reacts flatly and drinks.
Tibby admits he hid the news; Del quietly asks him to save her a spot.
Tibby tears up, Paisley holds him, and all five gather in the basin as rain starts.

s02228.summary: Dessa and Barn stand in flooded crypt water; Barn feels something touch his leg.
A pale hand rises and a creature lunges; Dessa hits it and they escape.
Safe behind the door, Barn notes the creature was the vicar.

s02299.summary: Nadia drills Darrell on dates and the knife before he testifies.
Asked if she believes him, Nadia says she believes the record and climbs.

s01823.summary: Yusuf reports seal failure as the outer door creeps open and air shrieks out.
Commander Isolde bursts in and patches the leak, closing the outer door.
Isolde scolds Yusuf, reports sealed, and hauls him up while he laughs shakily.

s01371_2.summary: Penny radios her father that Mister Tully came; he says Ezra died in March.
Penny turns to see the dripping dead man smiling; her lantern dies.
The beam flashes, Ezra vanishes, and Penny clutches the radio and counts.

s00661.summary: Five teens break into a planetarium gift shop and joke nervously about the quiet.
A hum from the dome unsettles them; Neri brightly accepts explanations.
Isaiah opens the curtain and Neri's father, thought absent, greets them from the projector.
The projector fills the dome with impossible stars and Gregory tells them to sit.

s00147.summary: Exhausted Solveig logs a repeating signal and plays back her earlier recordings.
The pulse interval shortens, and the pulse continues from her recorder after she stops it.
The recorder answers her hello and calls her to come; she drops it and refuses.
The pulse fades, the signal turns ordinary, and Solveig finds her tea warm.

s01235.summary: Six regulars hold a wake for Gus, trading small memories and laughing quietly.
Frankie and Rufus say they will miss Gus together, startled by the echo.

s00239.summary: Four travelers plan to cross a bridge of bones, bickering about fog and risk.
A gust halts them midway; something large exhales in the fog below.
The wind drops and they sprint across the ringing bones to the far cliff.
Safe on grass, Aelfwyn hauls Grim up and the four set off down the road.

s01269.summary: Five employees wait for a forced huddle in a beige office under bright intercom cheer.
Horatio announces twelve percent efficiencies; Brigitte admits she does not know what they do.
Staff realize they produce no product, as Dez needles Reggie.
Regional VP Cranston-Lee appears unannounced, interrogates tenure, and says none have produced a claim.
He smiles and demands twelve percent more nothing; the staff toast to nothing.

s01330.summary: Gran and Beans wait in the stalled ice cream truck, bickering about dials and wrenches.
Beans admits he only got to be the tree; Gran says trees hold the stage up.
Beans notes her purse dripping, and they laugh about the pistachio ice cream.

s01421.summary: Tucker and Isaac wait in the salt flats; Tucker bluntly demands water.
Billie brings jerky and trades dry banter while they wait for a late man with a wagon.
A dust smudge appears; they watch it and Tucker says nobody acts until he says.
The dust dies away and the three settle back to wait.

s01660.summary: Detective Inez enters a carousel factory where Carmine, Dorothea, Vlad and Reggie wait tensely.
Inez presses Carmine about a missing girl and a pony he carved for her.
Dorothea defends her gentle carver while Vlad fidgets and Inez notices.
Inez finds a grey pony inscribed For Wren, and silence falls.
Reggie bolts into the rain with Vlad chasing; Carmine blocks Inez's gun.
Carmine points to the attic trapdoor where the girl waits, and Inez climbs.

s01422.summary: Lenore learns by phone that the hearing moved earlier.
Lenore tells nervous Rufus to say nothing and promises she will object.

s01697.summary: Dr. Amara and Nurse Wojtek quietly chart and check incubators at three a.m.
A baby flatlines and they perform compressions and medication until a heartbeat returns.
Shaken, they trade a look; Wojtek sits and Amara writes the chart.

s01652.summary: Chiara takes the spoon from her father and corrects his sauce.
Luca bursts in with a one-antler reindeer and Nonno calls it brave.
Sabina scolds Enzo's supervising, touches his cheek, and he speaks of his illness.
Sabina tells weeping Chiara to cry on the pasta; all laugh as singing starts.

s01404.summary: Moe deals cards, calling Zofia sweetheart; she bristles at his patronizing tone.
Zofia plays a recording of Moe pinning the Kessler job on her; he laughs.

s01446.summary: Supervisor Croft corrects Eunice while an impatient caller complains of delay.
Eunice connects the call and earns Miss Croft's faint approval.

s01472_1.summary: The crew creeps through a salt mine, settling that drilling the vault wall is too loud.
Raff spots an automated ore train and they hide behind a cart as its beam searches.
The track switches, the train recedes, and the crew hurries on.

s01734.summary: Security guard Mirelle questions Cassian about a ticking suitcase he does not remember packing.
Janitor Obadiah says he cut the radio line and drops his act.
Mirelle draws her gun; Obadiah says they share a past flight; a red shoe rides the carousel.

s01772.summary: Keeper Silas bristles as inspector Hobart climbs through a gale to check his lamp.
Silas offers tea, Hobart refuses to sit, and Thaddeus lights the stove as the beam sweeps.

s02406.summary: Mrs. Hargreave hears the dumbwaiter rope creak in the silent kitchen.
A voice calls her name from the shaft and the hatch opens on its own.
Dr. Pemberton arrives and she says her husband is in the wall; the gas dies.

s02127.summary: A frosted stranger drags a sled to the stranded whaler and asks for warmth.
Annika lowers her rifle and the crew take him in and feed him.
Hollis says the coast is two weeks away, dryly joking they have had supper.

s01273.summary: Widow Abigail insists on seeing her husband's body in the embalming room.
She touches the body's cheek and says he is warm.
The corpse's chest rises, Hollis finds no pulse, and the body whispers Abigail.
Abigail rises smiling to answer, the lights die, and the body vanishes with her.

s01861.summary: June climbs a rooftop water tower at dawn and startles when Oscar appears.
Oscar claims he arrived first and offers her iced coffee in November.
Oscar's sister calls him home; they agree to meet again tomorrow.

s00310.summary: Commander Yusuf reports oxygen for four days against nine days to relief.
Iris admits they are not fine; Helena holds her hand while Tomasz stares.

s01642.summary: Customers, a cop and a doorman argue in the pawnshop closing sale.
Rosalind flashes her badge; Trey smashes the case and bolts with the ring.

s02242.summary: Halcyon reveals an unregistered crew member and Orrin demands who she is.
Pavlina, a dismissed engineer, says the reactor will blow in four hours.
Orrin accepts her help and she opens the bulkhead onto the pulsing reactor core.
